title: Light Uruguayan Kale Salad
description: A refreshing and healthy salad featuring kale, citrus, and a touch of heat, perfect for a post-workout snack
instructions: In a large bowl, massage the kale with your hands for about 2 minutes to make it tender
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper
Add the orange segments, red pepper flakes, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the kale
Pour the dressing over the kale mixture and toss to combine
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Transfer the salad to a mason jar and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional pumpkin seeds if desired
